name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2102: A second machine sat on v945 and nothing ever said so. The behind-check had existed since v817 but could only run if you CLICKED the version in the footer, and the comment above it claimed a banner that was never written. Meanwhile the API told every platform to relaunch to auto-pull - false: no Mac launcher pulled at all, and the Windows one skips the pull whenever the console is already up. The console now checks on load and every 30 minutes, paints a real banner, and UPDATE NOW performs a guarded fast-forward.
